hooks.text: The Moon formed in hours, but part of its maker never left.
A Mars-sized planet smashed into our world four point five billion years ago.
Two continent-sized alien blobs are buried deep inside Earth right now.

title: The Alien World Buried Inside Earth
description: A Mars-sized planet once vaporized the infant Earth, leaving continent-sized remnants hidden thousands of miles beneath our feet.

beats.text: The Moon formed in hours, but part of its maker never left.
beats.visual: High-resolution simulation of the giant impact hypothesis, 2022

beats.text: Many believe the Moon slowly formed from orbiting debris over millions of years.
beats.visual: NASA artist concept of the Moon-forming debris disk, 2015
queries: Protoplanetary disk debris disk artist concept

beats.text: Four point five billion years ago, a Mars-sized world named Theia smashed into our infant Earth.
beats.visual: Artist illustration of the planet Theia colliding with early Earth, 2020
queries: Giant impact hypothesis illustration Theia Earth

beats.text: High-resolution simulations now show this collision could have formed the Moon in just a few hours.
beats.visual: Simulation still of the Moon forming in hours, 2022

beats.text: But Theia did not just break apart; our own planet swallowed the intruder whole.
beats.visual: NASA artist illustration of the Hadean Earth's magma ocean, 2011

beats.text: Massive iron-rich structures sit eighteen hundred miles deep beneath Africa and the Pacific Ocean.
beats.visual: Diagram of Large low-shear-velocity provinces inside Earth, 2021

beats.text: Two continent-sized blobs inside Earth are the ancient relics of Theia.
beats.visual: 3D model of mantle blobs sitting above Earth's core, 2023

beats.text: Deep underground lies the heart of the intruder that never left.
beats.visual: Cross-section diagram of Earth's internal layers, 2021
